0022600208.text: The Rockets (7-3) enter this home game as the 2nd-place team in the Southwest, one game back, and sixth in the West after dropping their last two. The Nuggets (5-3 in eight games) are 9th in the West and two games back in the Northwest, and they have won their last two. Houston is missing Clint Capela (ankle sprain), Oscar Tshiebwe (illness), and Steven Adams (calf strain), while Denver is without Julian Strawther (knee sprain) and has Aaron Gordon, Cameron Johnson, Christian Braun, DeMar DeRozan, Jamal Murray, and Nikola Jokic listed as day-to-day with game-time decisions. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and Denver won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 129-93 Nuggets win in Denver on March 11, 2026.
